name: Universidad CEU San Pablo
summary: Private university in Madrid; 15 bachelor's with a confirmed English route, from dentistry and physiotherapy to data science and design.

ib.text: Apply with your grades, a motivation letter and ID, then interview. IB holders need the UNEDasiss credential to enrol. English-track students certify B2 English by the end of year 2.

programmes.name: Business Administration and Management
programmes.about: Business administration with two specialisation tracks in years 3 and 4, offered in an English group, with one or two semesters abroad possible.
programmes.selectionNote: Decided on your grades, a motivation letter and an interview with a lecturer; online tests (English, maths for some) may follow.

programmes.name: Business Administration and Management + Marketing
programmes.about: Two degrees in five years, business administration and marketing, which you can study in English.

separateFrom.name: Business Administration and Management
separateFrom.reason: A five-year dual degree: two degrees, its own study plan and fee.

programmes.selectionNote: Decided on your grades, a motivation letter and an interview with a lecturer; online tests (English, maths for some) may follow.

programmes.name: Computer Engineering
programmes.about: Programming, cybersecurity, systems, databases and software at CEU's Institute of Technology, with 40 places in the English group.
programmes.selectionNote: Decided on your grades, a motivation letter and an interview with a lecturer; online tests (English, maths for some) may follow.

programmes.name: Data Science and Engineering
programmes.about: Data science and engineering in a 100%-English group of 30 places (a separate Spanish group also runs).
programmes.selectionNote: Decided on your grades, a motivation letter and an interview with a lecturer; online tests (English, maths for some) may follow.

programmes.name: Data Science and Data Engineering + Information Systems Engineering
programmes.about: Two engineering degrees in five years, taught in English, with tracks such as bioinformatics and business information systems.

separateFrom.name: Data Science and Engineering
separateFrom.reason: A five-year dual degree: two degrees, its own study plan and fee.

separateFrom.name: Computer Engineering
separateFrom.reason: A five-year dual degree: two degrees, its own study plan and fee.

programmes.selectionNote: Decided on your grades, a motivation letter and an interview with a lecturer; online tests (English, maths for some) may follow.

programmes.name: Dentistry
programmes.about: A five-year dentistry degree that you can study entirely in English, with clinical training at CEU's Faculty of Medicine.
programmes.selectionNote: Decided on your grades, a motivation letter and an interview with a lecturer; online tests (English, maths for some) may follow.

programmes.name: Physiotherapy
programmes.about: Physiotherapy at CEU's Faculty of Medicine, offered entirely in English as well as in Spanish.
programmes.selectionNote: Decided on your grades, a motivation letter and an interview with a lecturer; online tests (English, maths for some) may follow.

programmes.name: International Relations and the European Union
programmes.about: International relations and EU studies taught in English at the Law School, with cases, simulations and debates, and an option to add a second degree.
programmes.selectionNote: Decided on your grades, a motivation letter and an interview with a lecturer; online tests (English, maths for some) may follow.

programmes.name: Advertising and Public Relations
programmes.ib: English track taught in English except the Spanish language course, the final project and internships.
programmes.about: A practical, multidisciplinary advertising and PR degree that you can take entirely in English apart from a few components.
programmes.selectionNote: Decided on your grades, a motivation letter and an interview with a lecturer; online tests (English, maths for some) may follow.

programmes.name: Audiovisual Communication
programmes.ib: English track taught in English except the Spanish language course, the final project and internships.
programmes.about: Audiovisual communication with an international profile, available in English apart from a few components.
programmes.selectionNote: Decided on your grades, a motivation letter and an interview with a lecturer; online tests (English, maths for some) may follow.

programmes.name: Digital Communication
programmes.about: Digital communication including virtual reality, gamification and interactive environments, with an English option.
programmes.selectionNote: Decided on your grades, a motivation letter and an interview with a lecturer; online tests (English, maths for some) may follow.

programmes.name: Journalism
programmes.ib: CEU says the English track is taught almost entirely in English.
programmes.about: Journalism that CEU offers almost entirely in English, with exchanges with universities in 25 countries.
programmes.selectionNote: Decided on your grades, a motivation letter and an interview with a lecturer; online tests (English, maths for some) may follow.

programmes.name: Fundamentals of Architecture
programmes.about: The new architecture bachelor's, with 100%-English or 100%-Spanish training; design, sustainability and urban planning.
programmes.selectionNote: Decided on your grades, a motivation letter and an interview with a lecturer; online tests (English, maths for some) may follow.

programmes.name: Interior Design
programmes.about: Four years creating and rehabilitating interior spaces, with an English group of 40 places.
programmes.selectionNote: Decided on your grades, a motivation letter and an interview with a lecturer; online tests (English, maths for some) may follow.

programmes.name: Fashion Design and Management and its Industry
programmes.about: Creating, leading and positioning fashion brands, with an English group of 30 places at CEU's creativity campus.
programmes.selectionNote: Decided on your grades, a motivation letter and an interview with a lecturer; online tests (English, maths for some) may follow.

notes: Most degrees run a Spanish and an English group; the English group costs more per credit, and the fees shown are the 2026/27 English prices.
Admitted students pay a €950 place reservation fee (€1,500 for Dentistry) and a €1,500–2,000 enrolment fee.
Financial Markets and Data Analysis, taught in English, is listed as coming soon and is not included here.
